dct_description_sm:
Features related to provincially tracked species and species at risk are not available as open data. Sensitive features are subject to licensing and approvals. Visit the Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry website to get access to natural heritage information. 

Identifies the geographic area in which a search for one or more species was conducted through data collection and surveys. The boundaries of a Search Area may be identical to a plot, a protected area, an ecoregion, flight transect or some other defined type of location. 
 
The geometry for a Species Search Area is typically not reused. If a search is done in the same area at a later date, a new polygon will need to be created.

dct_rights_sm: This data is subject to terms of use. Features related to provincially tracked species and species at risk are not available as open data. Sensitive features are subject to licensing and approvals. Visit the Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry website (https://www.ontario.ca/page/get-natural-heritage-information) to get access to natural heritage information. Use Restrictions: This class will be available to named users only who have undergone NHIC Data Sensitivity Training and have a data sharing agreement with NHIC. This class contains exact locations of Provincially Tracked Species (including SAR), and has medium sensitivity. Observer names will be stored in a secured table. Other than the name, no other personal information will be stored. Observer names are required for observation follow-up and information credibility (professional vs. amateur).
